findings.correction: Fail the owned phase promptly from an active guard and retain the reason; cancel/join only the new owner tree, never healthy histories.
findings.finding: MemAvailable96GiB and Docker-root295833415680 checks occur only in resource_ok after the entire body. The sampler does not stop the new owned phase when either live reserve is crossed.

findings.correction: Provide bounded exact-owner-ID/label-aware cleanup in the surviving owner after child-tree join, including private network. Use shell cleanup receipts when available and retain any incomplete cleanup without deleting unrelated resources.
findings.finding: Outer guard timeout/disk/log failure can terminate or kill the shell tree. Cleanup exists only in shell EXIT trap; Python finally only stops the sampler and later audits surviving containers. That does not guarantee fixture cleanup on every abnormal completion.

findings.correction: Synchronously retain initial and final snapshots, read owner/container memory.peak and memory.events when available, and make traversal/read errors explicit. Preserve already-seen vs not-yet-created lifecycle states and any gaps.
findings.finding: The asynchronous sampler has no required prelaunch initial or post-cleanup final row, memory.peak/events are not read, and os.walk silently ignores directory traversal errors. A missing/inaccessible directory can be reported as a zero or partial available allocation.

findings.correction: Seal a FAIL_OR_INCOMPLETE terminal in an outer finally for every post-launch path, carrying actual process wait, observation errors, cleanup observations and parse/binding failures.
findings.finding: Terminal Docker queries, cleanup receipt reads, body JSON reads and post-binding checks are outside an enclosing durable finalization handler. An exception there can omit the owner terminal receipt after the test already ran.

findings.correction: Freeze and independently review the final job. Require the two exact approved histories and no unadmitted DB workload; bind empty baseline or separately admit every running container. Ensure owned telemetry includes every actual body evidence/TMPDIR/fixture/model-cwd location, or make body evidence destination follow the sealed job.
findings.finding: Job history_bodies, baseline_running_container_ids, bindings and owned_directories remain caller-supplied; len(history_bodies)<=2 alone does not establish the exact approved fixture class or require baseline DB census empty. The body executor writes evidence under its fixed f67 directory even if the outer phase_root differs.

positive_findings: Full normal model scope, exact root census, prebuilt test2json/image/helper bindings and separate DB forecast checks are present.
Data-floor enforcement is passed to the streaming process guard.
Owned-directory allocated-byte/inode telemetry and exact CID memory reads are present; container logging is rotated at8m x2 and shell file output limit is256MiB.
Shell service cleanup verifies exact container owner labels/service labels/restart=no and removes only owned IDs; private-network ownership is checked before removal.
result: The adopted prospective model resource estimates remain unchanged. The draft is not yet a concrete reviewed launch owner.
